[The role of metformin in the cardiokidney-metabolic patient]. Metformin is a first-line drug in the treatment of type2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) due to its efficacy, safety, and cost-effectiveness. Its main mechanism of action is the reduction of hepatic gluconeogenesis, improving insulin sensitivity and modulating glucose metabolism.
